parameters.content:
## Error Trigger Node

**WHAT IT DOES:**
* Creates a separate error workflow
* Automatically runs when linked workflow fails
* Provides error details in structured format
* Does not need to be activated

**IMPORTANT:**
This node does not work with manually triggered workflows

**ERROR DATA AVAILABLE:**
* `workflow.name` - Failed workflow name
* `execution.id` - Execution identifier
* `error.message` - Error description
* `error.node.name` - Which node failed
* `execution.url` - Link to execution

**SETUP:**
1. Create new workflow
2. Add Error Trigger as first node
3. Add notification nodes
4. Link in main workflow settings

**REFERENCE:**
https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/core-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.errortrigger/

## Exercise

**TASK**
1. Set up Slack notifications in this workflow
2. Go to the [example error workflow](https://shared-n8n.bitovi-ai.com/workflow/r3oMop6Q2SXsmx0Z)
3. Make sure that the example workflow is linked to the error workflow (··· in the upper right corner -> Settings -> Error Workflow -> point to the error workflow called `Error Trigger`)
4. Activate  the workflow
4. Wait for 30 seconds and check if you got a Slack notification
5. Fix the workflow to eliminate the error

**SUCCESS CRITERIA:**
✓ Friendly alerts sent appropriately
✓ Error workflow activates on failure
✓ Notifications include useful context
